nom: MAREE Exfoliating Toner with Salicylic Acid

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including one in her 60s who says toner usually burns her face, consistently report no stinging, burning, or redness from this one.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report mixed results: some say it controls an oily T-zone and works well for oily, acne-prone skin, while one reviewer with oily, breakout-prone skin found it too gentle to noticeably smooth her skin or unclog pores.
segments.combination: The one reviewer with combination skin reports no significant irritation and fewer bumps with a more even tone after several weeks.
segments.mature: The one reviewer who describes her skin as mature, in her 60s, reports it doesn't burn or redden her face the way toners usually do.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the toner as non-drying and hydrating rather than stripping, including one whose stubborn dry patch nearly disappeared after two weeks of use.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report the toner does not cause redness and, in a couple of cases, that their skin looked less red or irritated with continued use.
concerns.barrier: The large majority of reviewers, across sensitive, mature, and combination skin, report no stinging, burning, or irritation, with one noting only a normal, mild tingling on application; a few reviewers also flag that the AHA/BHA acids increase sun sensitivity, so sunscreen is needed the next day.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports visible fading of skin discoloration and sun damage on her cheeks after about a week of use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report clearer skin, fewer breakouts, and better-controlled blackheads with regular use; a couple of reviewers who normally rely on stronger 2% salicylic acid products, however, found this one too mild to keep their breakouts under control.
concerns.oiliness: The two reviewers who mention oil control report the toner helped balance an oily T-zone and left oily, acne-prone skin feeling fresh and clean.

aspects.libelle: Thin, watery texture, not gel-like as advertised
Good bottle size and value for the price
Bottle pours too fast to control

extraits.texte: I got this because I normally use 2% salicylic acid to keep my breakouts under control. This toner has a combination of other types of acids along with the salicylic - maybe the percentage of salicylic is too reduced by the others? I have been using it on the 'T' zone on my face but it doesn't seem to be doing as effective a job at keeping my breakouts at bay. While I like the product, I don't think I'll be buying this again.

extraits.titre: Well-Rounded Ingredients but Lacks Exfoliating Power
extraits.texte: I recently tried the MAREE Exfoliating Toner with Salicylic Acid, and unfortunately, it didn't work as well as I had hoped. Given that it’s marketed as an exfoliant, I expected it to be a bit more effective in addressing my oily skin and breakouts. While I appreciate that the toner is very gentle, it may be too gentle for my needs. It seems like it would be better suited for those with more sensitive skin rather than someone looking for a stronger exfoliating effect. I didn't see the improvements I was hoping for in terms of smoothing my skin or unclogging pores. That said, the ingredients are good, and the formulation suggests a well-rounded approach, targeting hydration, exfoliation, soothing, and protection. This makes it a potentially effective choice for many skin types. If you have sensitive skin and are looking for a mild exfoliant, this might be a good option.

Since, I'm in my 60's I have mature skin but it's also quite sensitive so I'm always very hesitant about what products I use on my face. Because of this, toner isn't something I've been using because it sometimes burns my face. My skin hasn't been looking great lately so I decided to try this product. I was very pleased to find this product doesn't have a harsh smell and it's not perfumed like a lot of other products. I can detect a slight smell when sniffing the top of the bottle but not much. When I used it on my face, I couldn't smell the product at all. The product is very easy to use by applying with a cotton ball or fingertips. I opted for a cotton ball. The toner dried quickly and afterwards, I applied my regular serums and moisturizers. I did not have any burning sensation after application of the product & my skin hasn't shown the tell-tale redness that I get from product sensitivity. Overall, I'm very pleased with this product even though I've only been using it for a short time. I love that this product is an American product, not tested on animals & that it's fragrance free.

I quite like this toner. I have super sensitive skin and this has had no ill effects. It has absolutely no sting on any level. It has absolutely no smell either, which I like. I use my fingertips to apply to my face and chest and let it sit around for 5 or so minutes. It sinks into the skin completely and there's no tackiness or feeling after it sinks in. The bottle is pretty big and this should last a year, applying with fingertips.

I was skeptical at first, but the MAREE Exfoliating Toner really lives up to the hype. It’s helped control my oily T-zone and minimized the appearance of pores. My skin feels cleaner and looks more radiant after every use. It’s unscented, lightweight, and non-sticky formula gives that fresh, post-facial glow without any redness. I use it 3-4 times a week at night, and I’ve already noticed fewer breakouts. Highly recommend if you want a toner that gently resurfaces skin while keeping acne and dullness under control.

extraits.auteur: Just A Girl That Loves Her Dogs
extraits.texte: I am very impressed with this exfoliating toner. Before this purchase, I was unaware that toner could also serve as an exfoliator. This toner contains glycolic, lactic, mandelic, and salicylic acid. The glycolic acid breaks down the gunk holding down your skin cells, the lactic acid helps with exfoliation and provides some moisturization, the mandelic acid promotes cell turnover, leading to a smoother texture, reducing fine lines, and a brighter, more even complexion, and the salicylic acid cleanses pores by dissolving oils and buildup. This is some excellent stuff. I am very, very pleased with the results. I had a patch of dry skin that I could not get rid of, no matter what I tried. After using this for two weeks, it is almost completely gone. My husband has even started using it. I can not praise it enough.

extraits.titre: Easy to apply and works well
extraits.texte: This exfoliating toner is a straightforward and effective product for anyone looking to tackle clogged pores and uneven skin texture. The formula, which combines salicylic acid (BHA) with AHAs, works to gently dissolve dead skin cells, excess oil, and other impurities that can lead to breakouts. I found it to be particularly useful for keeping blackheads and congestion around the nose and chin under control. The liquid has a lightweight, watery consistency that absorbs quickly without leaving a sticky or heavy residue. It did not cause any significant irritation on my combination skin, though it has a slight tingling sensation upon application which is normal for this type of active product. After several weeks of use, my skin appeared smoother and more refined, with noticeably fewer bumps and a more even tone. The packaging is functional with a screw top lid, though pouring a small amount directly from the bottle can be a bit tricky; using a cotton pad is recommended for easier application. The value for the amount of product you receive is good, especially considering the quality of the ingredients. For those seeking a reliable chemical exfoliant to incorporate into their weekly routine, this is a solid choice. It is effective yet gentle enough for most skin types when used as directed. Just remember to follow up with a good moisturizer and, most importantly, sunscreen the next day, as AHAs can increase sun sensitivity.
